'''Glowen Faquidde''' was a [[Color|white]]-skinned member of a [[humanoid]] [[alien]] [[Glowen Faquidde's species|species]] who spent [[time]] in the [[Canto Casino and Racetrack|Canto Casino]] on the [[planet]] [[Cantonica]] in [[34 ABY]]. Faquidde sat near one of the [[casino]]'s bars with a diminutive alien and a drink while several galloping [[fathier]]s caused the casino to shake as they raced on the nearby Canto Bight racetrack.

==Biography==
Glowen Faquidde was an [[alien]]<ref name="TLJVD" /> who was present in the [[city]] of [[Canto Bight]] on the [[planet]] [[Cantonica]] during the [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] between the [[First Order]] and the [[Resistance]]<ref name="TLJ">{{Film|VIII}}</ref> in [[34 ABY]].<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|VIII}} to [[34 ABY]].</ref> Faquidde sat with a [[glass]] of amber liquid next to a diminutive [[alien]] at a table near a bar inside the [[Canto Casino and Racetrack|Canto Casino]] while the Resistance agents [[Rose Tico]] and [[Finn]] [[Mission to Canto Bight|searched]] the establishment for the patron known as the [[Master Codebreaker]]. While the alien pair sat together gesturing and conversing, the [[casino]] shook around them as several [[fathier]]s raced past on the nearby Canto Bight racetrack.<ref name="TLJ" /> Faquidde at some point also stood with the casino's [[hotel]] concierge [[Terrib Igmusk]].<ref name="Bucket">{{BucketsList|E_DxK2LQKFM|#1.14: "Dangerous Business"|sw_url=video/buckets-list-dangerous-business-star-wars-resistance}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Glowen Faquidde was a member of a [[humanoid]] alien [[Glowen Faquidde's species|species]] with [[Color|white]] skin and at least two [[Limb|arms]] ending in hands,<ref name="TLJVD" /> each with four fingers and a thumb.<ref name="TLJ" /> Faquidde's head included two blue, front-facing [[eye]]s with large pupils, and a series of pink tendrils hanging down below the chin.<ref name="TLJVD" />

==Equipment==
Faquidde wore patterned black [[Clothing|robes]] with a hood and white lining while in the Canto Bight casino.<ref name="TLJVD" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:King_29.png|thumb|right|200px|Ivan Manzella drew concept art of Glowen Faquidde.]]
Glowen Faquidde was portrayed by creature performer<ref name="TLJ" /> [[Lynn Robertson Bruce]]<ref name="Twitter">{{Twitter|NickKellington|1182332563437821960|[[Nick Kellington]]|quote=It has been confirmed! The wonderful Lynn Robertson Bruce is indeed #24|archivedate=20191010163903if_}}</ref> and first appeared in the [[sequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']],<ref name="TLJ" /> which was released on [[December 15]], [[2017]].<ref name="Release Date">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-episode-viii-to-open-december-15-2017|text=''Star Wars: Episode VIII'' to Open December 15, 2017}}</ref> The character was identified in the reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: The Visual Dictionary]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]<ref name="TLJVD" /> and released on the same day as the film.<ref name="Penguin">{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/558520/star-wars-the-last-jedi--the-visual-dictionary-by-pablo-hidalgo|text=Star Wars The Last Jedi The Visual Dictionary}} {{C|US hardcover}}</ref> Concept art of the character, titled "King 29," was produced for the film by senior sculptor [[Ivan Manzella]].<ref name="Art">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Last Jedi]]''</ref>

Faquidde also appeared in the children's activity book ''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi Look and Find]]'', which was illustrated by [[Art Mawhinney]]<ref name="Look&Find">''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi Look and Find]]''</ref> and also released the same day as the film.<ref name="Amazon">{{Amazon|url=Disney-Star-Wars-9781503728103-Available/dp/1503728102|text=Disney - Star Wars Episode VIII The Last Jedi Look and Find Book - PI Kids}}</ref> The book incorrectly depicts the character with brown, two-fingered hands rather than the white-skinned hands with at least four fingers that the character has in the film.<ref name="Look&Find" />
